textRuns.value: Top table: the leadership responsibility matrix (owner-provided framework) - the CEO/CCO set strategy, the COO runs operations, the CFO brings the economics. Bottom table: every ratio from the matrix as a calc card - the formula, WHERE IT COMES FROM on the current-revision IRS Form 990 (part/line), a worked example, and how to read it.

Source types: FORM 990 = straight off the core form via the tab-11 links · 990 SCHEDULE / 990 PARTIAL = schedule data or form gives only part · INTERNAL DATA = not on any 990, needs management accounts · MODULE = already computed live on tabs 9-13. Verify line references against the filed return - form revisions move lines occasionally.
